directive.quote: Replace only its source: file reads and writes become door records reads and writes.

job: keep a door move's lease, cutover and journal receipts as rows of the person's list, each save conditioned on the value last read

distinct_from.why: Its save(file, lease) wrote the lease receipt to a mode-600 file; this keeps the same receipts as list rows through the records door. That file leaves with the older owner's door scripts.
Its save(file, receipt) wrote the cutover receipt to a file; the same receipts become list rows here. That file leaves with the older owner's door scripts.
Its journal(file, receipt) wrote the move's journal to a file; the same journal becomes a list row here. That file leaves with the older owner's door scripts.
This tool's own README, describing doorReceipts; documentation, not another owner.
The door's row functions: they import doorReceipts and hand it to the lease and cutover code; a caller, it keeps no receipts itself.
The door move: it imports doorReceipts over the records it is given; a caller, it keeps no receipts itself.
This tool's own tests: they make their receipts with doorReceipts over a made-up door and read the record:public-door-receipt rows a run kept; they test this job, they do not do it.
This tool's own rows, granting records:read and records:write on record:public-door-receipt for the receipts this file keeps; the rows, not a second owner.
